request.text: [threatening] Turn your column around. The next ant on my road goes home in pieces.

text: Turn your column around. The next ant on my road goes home in pieces.

voice.description: A beetle savant and keeper of a great machine, about fifty: a cold, clipped, nasal baritone, arrogant and condescending, precise like a clockmaker, contemptuous of outsiders, with a slight metallic dryness. He speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.
